description: EPREM follows energetic-ion acceleration and transport through the heliosphere on a grid moving with the solar wind. Its focused-transport calculation can use magnetic-field, velocity and plasma-density information from coupled models. The resource is documented by University of New Hampshire. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere, Heliosphere / Outer Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented uncoupled configuration uses a simplified background solar wind. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
